correctness.rationale: Exact end-letter subsequence states give 3x3 transfer matrices. Explicit integer-polynomial 3-state and 9-state vector identities algebraically certify the complete two-variable rational generating functions, including empty and constant-word boundaries. Exact independent set enumeration and all-composition checks corroborate through lengths 9 and 11; iid finite identity tests through 31. The closed-form iid variance follows by proven specialization and partial fractions.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Knowledge of E[D] alone, even for all compositions or all letter biases, cannot logically determine E[D²]. An upper bound or maximum of D cannot imply the exact variance. A fixed two-deletion output statistic differs because this result simultaneously counts outcomes of every possible subsequence length. No inspected source gives a theorem whose consequence supplies the evaluated nine-state rational function.
